# talos-argocd-proxmox

> Current repository context for AI assistants. Use this as a reading map;
> operational procedures and detailed rules live in the linked sources.

GitOps Kubernetes on Talos OS and Proxmox, provisioned through Omni and managed
by ArgoCD. ApplicationSets discover app directories; infrastructure paths are
listed explicitly. PVC backups use kopiur with restore-before-bind. Postgres
runs as app-owned Deployments backed up by kopiur; CNPG/Barman is retired.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — Codex entrypoint and explicit Mink capture rules.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — shared repository rules, GitOps workflow, sync waves,
  secrets, storage, and links to directory-specific CLAUDE.md files.
- [docs/index.md](docs/index.md) — canonical documentation map.
- [docs/easy-guide.md](docs/easy-guide.md) — introduction to the platform.

## Operations and recovery

- [docs/disaster-recovery.md](docs/disaster-recovery.md) — rebuild prerequisites,
  recovery sequence, verification, and remaining operational boundaries.
- [docs/domains/argocd/entrypoints.md](docs/domains/argocd/entrypoints.md) —
  ApplicationSets, explicit entrypoints, and sync-wave ownership.
- [docs/domains/storage/kopiur-backup-architecture.md](docs/domains/storage/kopiur-backup-architecture.md)
  — backup and restore mechanics, per-PVC configuration, and verification.
- [docs/domains/storage/kopiur-mover-permissions.md](docs/domains/storage/kopiur-mover-permissions.md)
  — mover permissions must match the data owner.
- [docs/domains/cnpg/plain-postgres-migration.md](docs/domains/cnpg/plain-postgres-migration.md)
  — current plain-Postgres pattern and the completed CNPG retirement.
- [docs/domains/cnpg/run-postgres-plain-english.md](docs/domains/cnpg/run-postgres-plain-english.md)
  — operating the app-owned databases.

Do not use historical rebuild counts or retired operator procedures as current
instructions. Check the owning manifests and canonical runbook before acting.

## Self-hosted PostHog

- [docs/posthog-self-host-k8s.md](docs/posthog-self-host-k8s.md) — deployment,
  boot order, upgrades, and recovery.
- [my-apps/development/posthog/CLAUDE.md](my-apps/development/posthog/CLAUDE.md)
  — agent-facing file map and invariants.
- [my-apps/development/posthog/UPGRADE.md](my-apps/development/posthog/UPGRADE.md)
  — checks before changing PostHog images.

PostHog's Postgres stores its identity and configuration and is kopiur-backed.
ClickHouse, Kafka, and Redis are intentionally disposable; do not apply their
backup exemption to Postgres.
